title: Rav Nachman bar Natan

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bava Batra 8b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.8b.9). In the [Rosh’s reading there (siman 30)](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_on_Bava_Batra.1.30), Nachman bar Natan said, “Scripture says, ‘[They shall take the gold](https://www.sefaria.org/Exodus.28.5).’” Our text has simply Rav Nachman.

notes.text: The Rosh marker כ״ל differs from the historical OCR form ם״ל and remains unresolved. Hyman contrasts the Rosh’s full patronymic with bare Rav Nachman in his text.
In both linked accounts the gold quotation supports appointing at least two people to an office with public authority. The Rosh names Nachman bar Natan, while the consulted Gemara gives Rav Nachman.

Hyman’s print (vol. III, p. 945) reads ס״ל, where the supplied Hebrew has כ״ל and the earlier OCR has ם״ל. The Vilna Rosh, Bava Batra 1:30, names Nachman bar Natan with an abbreviated title. The consulted text of Bava Batra 8b has Rav Nachman without the patronymic. Both quote Exodus 28:5.
